integrity: Foundational age-structured Gaussian mixture and general Weibull weighted-sum large deviations are prior work; the assessed claim is the model-specific sharp spatial tail coefficient and renewal-shape history-dependence boundary. Analytical proof and a finite checker are present; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Logarithmic stationary coordinate and conditional-variance tails only; fixed positive physical parameters, Weibull off intervals and deterministic on durations. No density prefactor, multidimensional theorem, or joint parameter singular limit.
title: Sharp Weibull spatial tails and a collective-cycle threshold in intermittently confined Brownian diffusion
